audience: retailers and wholesalers who run orders, stock and accounting in Brightpearl

useCases.title: Find sales orders that still wait to be shipped
useCases.text: The AI searches orders by type, status and dates, then opens them to see statuses, totals and order rows.

useCases.title: Check stock of a product in each warehouse
useCases.text: The AI finds a product by SKU and reads in-stock, on-hand, allocated and in-transit quantities per warehouse.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their latest orders
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by email or name, reads the contact record, and finds the orders placed by that contact.

useCases.title: Check payments and shipments of orders
useCases.text: The AI searches customer payments received against sales orders and goods-out notes, which show picked, packed and shipped state.

useCases.title: Add a note or change the status of an order
useCases.text: The AI adds a private or public note to an order, or moves the order to another status. A status change can trigger other actions in Brightpearl.
